verdict.rationale: Adyen documents a standalone terminal option as 'the quickest way to accept in-person payments.' It also markets getting started fast with certified terminals, managing terminals from the Customer Area, and Tap to Pay with no extra hardware. However, the evidence never describes the actual pairing, boarding or registration flow, or how long it takes to reach a first payment. Missing for 10: documented steps for pairing a reader with the POS app or registering it to an account, evidence that a first payment is possible within minutes, and independent hands-on corroboration of setup speed.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can pair a card reader with the POS app or register it to my account and take a payment within minutes

citations.quote: If you do not need a fully featured API integration, and want the quickest way to accept in-person payments, we also offer a standalone terminal solution.
Get started fast with a full range of PCI PTS 6 certified terminals.
Lets you manage your payment terminals and transactions from our unified Customer Area.
Turn compatible smartphones or tablets into Tap to Pay checkouts. No extra hardware required.
